excerpt.zh: 该星球的地表上有着巨大的裂痕，从其图案判断，不可能是自然形成的。从轨道上看，这些裂痕看起来像是文字。
excerpt.en: There is significant scarring on the surface of this world in a pattern that cannot be natural. From orbit, the massive rifts look almost like writing.

texts.zh: 某人在大约五千年前用轨道上的采矿激光在[From.GetName]的表面雕刻了一篇巨大的文章，占据了[From.GetPlanetMoon]的大部分上半球地区，似乎讲述了一位外星佣兵的悲惨一生。
texts.en: Someone used a mining laser from orbit approximately five thousand years ago to carve a large body of writing into the surface of [From.GetName]. The massive script covers a large portion of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s upper hemisphere, and appears to be a short story chronicling the difficult life of an alien mercenary.
